name: Task_5
description:
Evaluate how isotropic lattice strain changes the optical phonon frequency of bulk Silicon. Start with a primitive diamond unit cell of Silicon (a = 5.43 \u00c5). The MACE-MP-0 foundation model should be used as the ASE-compatible calculator to describe interatomic interactions. Generate a dataset of five distinct deformed crystal structures by scaling the baseline lattice parameter by the fractions: -0.02, -0.01, 0.0, 0.01, 0.02. For each of the five configurations, compute the \u0393-point phonons using finite-displacement methods or analytical derivatives and extract the maximum positive vibrational frequency (which corresponds to the highest optical mode) in eV.

Use the same unrelaxed two-atom reference for every strain, natural silicon masses, primitive vectors a/2 × (0,1,1), a/2 × (1,0,1), a/2 × (1,1,0), and fractional positions (0,0,0) and (0.25,0.25,0.25). Apply only isotropic strain, and retain the calculation log so the evaluator can reconstruct the five highest positive phonon energies.
